challenge: The legacy core banking platform could not support real-time payments, and end-of-day batch windows were overrunning into business hours.
solution: A phased migration from the legacy core to a modern event-driven platform, run as a shadow migration so the old and new systems processed in parallel until cutover.

outcomes.metric: batch window shortened from 6 hours to 90 minutes

challenge: Manual regulatory reporting to BaFin consumed 3 weeks per quarter and was prone to reconciliation errors.
solution: An automated reporting pipeline with lineage tracking and a reconciliation engine, replacing spreadsheet-based assembly.

outcomes.metric: reporting cycle cut from 15 days to 3 days

challenge: Claims handlers spent hours manually keying data from scanned claim forms and supporting documents.
solution: An OCR and extraction pipeline that reads scanned claims, extracts structured fields, and routes low-confidence cases to human review.

challenge: A FlexCube-based core needed migration to a modern platform without disrupting branch operations.
solution: A migration readiness assessment followed by a phased data and contract migration, with a mock environment for parallel testing.

outcomes.metric: migration delivered 2 months ahead of schedule
branch downtime limited to a single weekend

challenge: An underused observability platform cost significant licence spend while incidents still took hours to diagnose.
solution: An observability maturity assessment, followed by instrumentation of critical payment paths and consolidation of dashboards and alerting.

outcomes.metric: licence spend reduced by 30% through consolidation

challenge: Client reporting data was scattered across four systems with no single source of truth.
solution: A consolidated data platform with a governed semantic layer and automated data-quality checks.

outcomes.metric: client report generation time cut from 4 days to 6 hours

challenge: New DORA operational-resilience requirements demanded evidence of ICT risk controls the bank could not readily produce.
solution: A control-evidence platform mapping ICT risks to controls, with automated evidence collection and an auditor-facing view.

challenge: Policy documents arrived in inconsistent formats, making automated underwriting checks impossible.
solution: A document normalisation and extraction service producing a consistent structured policy record.

challenge: Corporate onboarding required manually assembling entity profiles from dozens of scattered documents.
solution: An entity-profile extraction pipeline consolidating corporate documents into a single verified profile.

outcomes.metric: onboarding time reduced from 12 days to 4 days

challenge: A legacy reservation and account platform lacked API access, blocking digital channel development.
solution: A hexagonal ports-and-adapters wrapper exposing governed APIs over the legacy core, allowing incremental replacement.

outcomes.metric: first digital channel launched in 4 months

challenge: Deployments were manual and error-prone, with releases taking a full weekend of engineering time.
solution: A CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and blue-green deployment.

outcomes.metric: deployment time reduced from 2 days to 25 minutes

challenge: Reporting was slow and the society wanted to modernise its analytics stack.
solution: An assessment and roadmap for a modern analytics platform, followed by a proof of concept.
